import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_data = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().reset_index()
survival_pivot = survival_data.pivot(index='class', columns='sex', values='survived')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([not_survived_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#95E1D3'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()
colors_embark = ['#FFD93D', '#6BCB77', '#4D96FF']
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival['embarked'], embark_survival['mean'], 
               color=colors_embark, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port (C=Cherbourg, Q=Queenstown, S=Southampton)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
# Add count labels on bars
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, embark_survival['count'])):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.02,
             f'n={int(count)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300].copy()  # Remove outliers for better visualization
for pclass in sorted(df_fare['pclass'].unique()):
    class_data = df_fare[df_fare['pclass'] == pclass]
    survived = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 1]['fare']
    not_survived = class_data[class_data['survived'] == 0]['fare']
    
positions_base = pclass * 3
violin_parts1 = ax4.violinplot([not_survived.dropna()], positions=[positions_base - 0.5], 
                                widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
violin_parts2 = ax4.violinplot([survived.dropna()], positions=[positions_base + 0.5], 
                                widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    
    for pc in violin_parts1['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor('#FF6B6B')
        pc.set_alpha(0.6)
    for pc in violin_parts2['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor('#95E1D3')
        pc.set_alpha(0.6)

ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticks([3, 6, 9])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
# Manual legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.6, label='Did not survive'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#95E1D3', alpha=0.6, label='Survived')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
